description: Ex-RAF T8582, G-AKGU, then VT-DBK of Hyderabad Flying Club, presented to AFA 1975 (marked AFA-1975); restored 2002 and painted as spurious IAF HU838. Inside the AFA museum. Source WoI, BR.
Restored 2001-02 on circular platform outside the AFA museum with painted canopy cover. Source WoI, BR.
Outside the AFA museum beside the Harvard, restored with yellow bands. Source WoI, BR.
In service 1958-75 (FTW Hakimpet), at the Vampire Triangle near the Commandant's residence since 1974; restored, wooden nose replaced with aluminium, engine removed. Source WoI, BR.
c/n 272. Toofani Triangle, repainted with large serials and red nose stripe. Source WoI, BR.
c/n 254, fourth IAF Mystere; long marked only 938, repainted IA-938 in metal finish. Toofani Triangle. Source WoI, BR.
No.26 Sqn 1969; largest aircraft in the Toofani Triangle, restored to metal finish with serial moved to fin. Source WoI, BR.
Displayed in banking attitude beside the Sekhon block (ATC) since Dec 2004, no hardpoints or seat. Source WoI, BR.
Two-seater recovered from Bhatinda 2001 (No.31 Sqn markings), assembled and pole-mounted in climbing attitude right of the main entrance road in 2004. Source WoI, BR.
In front of the Flying Cadets Mess since before 1998, metal finish, serial painted on rear fuselage. Source WoI, BR.
No.30 Sqn Dec 1998; arrived 2009 and installed on a platform at the eastern corner of the Vampire Triangle. Source WoI, BR.
Second Kiran prototype with sliding canopy; pole-mounted in flying attitude near the ATC/War Memorial. Source WoI, BR.
Illuminated cutaway (X-ray) airframe made by the TETTRA school, first shown June 2005. Source WoI, BR.
Crash-landed at Tambaram 18 Jun 2003, converted to illuminated cutaway display, first shown Dec 2005. Source WoI.
Pulled from the grounded HPT-32 dump and installed at the AFA Sports Complex Aug 2014; MiG-25 drop tank from DS362 displayed nearby. Source WoI, BR.

Installed on a circular platform near the Cadets Mess after the Dec 2004 Iskra phase-out (W1741 was the one that landed, W1772 was installed). BR: serial re-used on replacement c/n 3H-1912. Source WoI, BR.
Listed by BR as pylon-mounted at AFA Dundigal (replacement airframe c/n 3H-1915). Source BR only.

One of two IAF Foxbat trainers (102 and 35 Sqn), flown to AFA May 2006, parked beside the Sekhon block; photographed well maintained June 2019 with canopy painted over. BR entries for DS361/DS362 have locations swapped. Source WoI 2022, BR.
aliases: DS-362; MiG25U; MiG-25RU; MiG25; DS362; MiG25RU

description: Ex-RAF WJ816, acquired 27 Aug 1971, flew 106 Sqn sorties in the 1971 war; flown to Dundigal at the 2007 retirement, on a platform beside the Sekhon block, repainted grey-green by 2019. Source WoI 2022, BR.
First rotary-wing exhibit at AFA, pylon-mounted at the new parade ground beside the museum in May 2016. Source WoI Jan 2024, BR.
Ex-224 Sqn, listed by BR as preserved at AFA Dundigal. Source BR only.
SA-2 missile on launcher displayed beside the runway (moved from the JCO Mess area 2003); a second SA-2 is at the main gate. First of two. Source WoI.
SA-2 missile installed at the AFA main gate. Second of two. Source WoI.
